marta_cs: Morning — quick BorealisTech VPC health snapshot for this week.
marta_cs: Regions summary: us-west-2: 99.995% uptime, 99p latency 42ms, errors 0.03%. eu-west-1: 99.96% uptime, 99p latency 58ms, errors 0.2% (TLS handshake spikes). ap-southeast-1: 99.88% uptime, 99p latency 72ms, errors 1.1% (KMS decrypt failures increased).
marta_cs: Spend +12% w/w driven by cache-miss storm in ap-southeast-1; token usage concentrated in that region.
liam_sre: Noted the KMS spike. Any recent key rotations or HSM ops we should correlate?
ana_eng: We rotated the HSM master key for Borealis prod at ~01:30 UTC last night. Saw intermittent decrypt failures in the rotation window. Logs: 
ana_eng: ```
2026-03-15T01:35:12Z KMS_CALL FailedToDecrypt KeyId=arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:... Err=IncorrectKeyMaterial
2026-03-15T01:35:13Z RETRY Attempt=2
2026-03-15T01:35:15Z KMS_CALL Success KeyId=...
```
ana_eng: Fallback worked (retries) but added ~600–1200ms to request latency and bumped error counts.
deploy-bot: deploy: borealis/vpc-kms-retry-enhancement queued by ana_eng — PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pulls/432
marta_cs: Action items: 1) liam_sre -> isolate KMS error rate, confirm HSM retry behavior and whether keys were partially propagated. 2) ana_eng -> push retry + metric change to track DecryptFailures. 3) marta_cs -> update Borealis CSM and flag renewal risk if customer sees >48h degradation.
liam_sre: I'll run the KMS replay and check HSM audit logs, ETA ~4h. Logging runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-hsm
ana_eng: Patch scheduled for 06:00 UTC; will canary in ap-southeast-1 for 30m then roll if green. Will add DecryptFailure metric and alert threshold.
marta_cs: Please prepare a short customer-facing blurb when we have the ETA for full resolution. If impact exceeds 48h we escalate to EDR and inform sales.
liam_sre: Ack — interim update in ~2h with findings. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marta_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup:
